verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a cloud provider like Railway, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of retention settings, deletion controls, or data-lifecycle policies. The one community remark about backups (railway-comm-8) is a sarcastic question, not affirmative evidence of user-controlled retention, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
